title: 促销与非促销的日均表现
context: 促销期天数不同，不能直接用总额比较。
requirements: 2025年线下订单，按日期是否落在任一促销区间分组；计算日均净销售、日均净件数、毛利率；日数来自完整日历，包含零销售日；不将相关性解释为因果。
commonError: 按订单数除总额得到客单价而不是日均。
executionSteps: 计算日均及加权毛利率
mysqlSql: WITH d AS (SELECT day,CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM promotions p WHERE day BETWEEN p.start_date AND p.end_date) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END promo FROM calendar_days WHERE day BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31'), a AS (SELECT order_date,SUM(net_cents) net,SUM(net_qty) qty,SUM(cost_cents) cost FROM v_sales_lines WHERE channel='store' AND order_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31' GROUP BY order_date) SELECT d.promo,COUNT(*) days,ROUND(1.0*SUM(COALESCE(a.net,0))/COUNT(*),2) daily_net_cents,ROUND(1.0*SUM(COALESCE(a.qty,0))/COUNT(*),2) daily_units,ROUND(100.0*SUM(a.net-a.cost)/NULLIF(SUM(a.net),0),2) margin_pct FROM d LEFT JOIN a ON a.order_date=d.day GROUP BY d.promo ORDER BY d.promo
